Hearing her say... that she still loves racing
was my only solace.

—Indeed. She wanted to connect.
To connect the people she saw with the things each of them held dear.
Here, thank you for your consideration.

Ah—it's just... so frustrating... It hurts so much...
Pisa... show me hope... Show me hope, Pisaaa...!
Even so, if nothing else... I want to keep hope alive in her heart...!
Still—it is lonely, isn't it?
Yaaah!
...Yes, you are right.

Her friend had left, and having lacked proper conditioning, she failed
to stretch out her final kick in the mock race—leaving her without any trainer scout offers.

..................
In the end, things didn't turn out for the best.

...Yes. Please take good care of yourself.
And... until we meet again someday.

Her rivals aren't soft enough to let her win while helping a friend.
And with her aiming for her own debut, she can't afford to neglect that either.

A few days later. When I stopped by the grounds, I saw Victoire Pisa
speaking with her friend with a solemn look on her face.
Is that... so...

There comes a time when one must think about their future and decide whether to push forward or step back.
For an athlete, that is an inevitable crossroads.

B-But Pisa, aren't you running in a mock race against Rose and the others too?
They're not opponents you can take lightly. You shouldn't be worrying about me—

That's why. The next mock race will be my last. If it doesn't pan out, I'm heading home!
And then, my dream of shining on the track... I'll entrust it to you, Pisa!

Her heart is still... connected to her racing dream.
If so... I want to do whatever I can to help.

I promise you. Even if I go back home, I'll always love racing.
Because you... reconnected me with my feelings for racing, Pisa!

It's alright.
I can simply stay behind and train more to make up for it.

...If this decision came from the bottom of your heart, I cannot stop you.
However... she did say 'the next one will be the last.'

Geez, don't look so down, Pisa~. I already knew it myself anyway.
I've tried my best for three years and haven't placed in the money even once in a mock race, right?

.
Well then, I'll go fetch some tea.

(...I can no longer change the fact that she's leaving the academy...
Even so—)

Let us work on improving this running form together before the mock race.
I'm certain you can still shave down your time.

...Man, she really looks so happy even though it's someone else's training.
Just watching her... makes the future feel bright. Haha, maybe it's just my imagination.

Circumstances or not, it has no bearing on the match.
Don't take it personally, Pisa...!
Yaaaah...!
Phew...!

—Yeah. It was the condition I promised my parents when I entered the academy.
If it looked like I had no future here, I'd go back home and attend a regular school.

...You know, it's strange. Even though I lost and have to leave,
Pisa's running is burned into my mind. As if telling me never to forget.

Victoire Pisa's friend gave it everything she had, setting a new personal best—
and finished her final challenge in 6th place.

I-It really looks just like the way I run...
I can't believe you can even copy that. You're so versatile, Pisa.

—I will not let my guard down for a moment. I will defeat you with everything I have.
Precisely because I know your potential.

If she intends to help her friend with hands-on demonstrations while doing
a full training routine of her own... that's clearly overwork.

—A few days later.
The day arrived for Victoire Pisa's friend to leave the academy.
Trainer...?

...Fufu. Then—let us connect them together.
Connecting the hearts across the world, until all loneliness is gone.
Believing that even after a rain of sorrow falls... skies of hope will appear—

Standing by them. Connecting hearts. Erasing loneliness from this world.
I believe that doing so will one day build a ring of hope connecting the entire world.

...You've been entrusted with your friend's hopes, I see. However—
I wouldn't be so tasteless as to hold back because of that...!
...I want to preserve the connection between your heart and racing.
Hah...!
—The next day.
Fufu, your time has improved this much in just five days.

... ...I understand.
That in the world of competition, things like this happen.
—And then came the day of the mock race.

So this is the form improvement plan you came up with, Trainer... It certainly
suits her well. Let's head outside right away and try it out.
